context_diary: When retrieving account information followed by finding an admin's email, I need to use account_lookup first to get the full profile, then traverse_hierarchy with direction "parent" repeatedly until reaching an ADMIN type. The hierarchy can have multiple agent levels before reaching the top admin. Each traverse_hierarchy call requires the previous parent's username to continue upward. This pattern of chained hierarchy traversal is necessary when dealing with multi-level agent structures where direct parents may not be admins.
